teacher_assumption: Original physical reference + one-step safe-minus-nominal speed/heading effect, then normalize and clip; not inverse MPC.
weight_assumption: Main Eq28 exponential norm of normalized rollout teacher - original normalized action.
intervention_threshold_assumption: Existing 1e-3 physical-control correction norm; not provided by main or cited papers.
minimum_speed_source: Main Paper III-D PDF p9: maintained minimum, not initial speed alone
minimum_speed_enforcement: reference lower bound + linear predicted MPC-speed constraints + CBF acceleration lower bound; no post-step speed clipping
scope_correction: v3 partial studies interrupted after discovering omitted minimum-speed condition; final study is v4
baseline_limitation: v2 had only initial speed, so the complete v2-v4 comparison includes a traffic-condition correction as well as teacher/weight changes
evaluation_status: best and final models, 50 episodes each at both speeds
